title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and former Orzhov leader who stays on Ravnica for Teysa, refuses Ezrim's offer, and finds Teysa murdered.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The head of the Orzhov Syndicate, who asks Kaya to return for a private talk and is found dead with her walking stick through her chest.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young Agency investigator who fetches Kaya and asks if she knows his father, the planeswalker Oko.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The archon head of the Agency, who offers Kaya leadership of the investigation.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A former Azorius asset turned Agency detective who interviews Etrata and helps her escape.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin held in Azorius custody who claims she remembers nothing of the murder and agrees to help Proft.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: The Simic leader, shaken by Zegana's death and angry.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: The murdered Simic figure.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker among the fae, Kellan's father.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who walked away from Ravnica and did not return.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who walked away from Ravnica and did not return.

events.summary: Azorius mages remove Etrata from Karlov Manor and no Dimir members intervene.
events.quote: Etrata's removal from the grounds of Karlov Manor took no time at all in the grand scheme of things.

events.summary: Teysa's remark about walking away stirs Kaya's memory of Jace and Vraska.
events.quote: Teysa had managed to invoke the shades of Jace and Vraska, the other two people who'd walked away from Ravnica.

events.summary: Teysa reports Vannifar is moving from grief to outrage over Zegana's death.
events.quote: Vannifar won't allow this to go unanswered.

events.summary: Kaya presses Teysa to say what she wanted to tell her; they agree on three days.
events.quote: Then, if you haven't called me, I come looking.

events.summary: Rumors about the party circulate through Ravnica, and people blame planeswalkers for the invasion.
events.quote: They talked about the Phyrexian invasion and how the Planeswalkers had failed them all.

events.summary: Kellan finds Kaya at a coffee shop to summon her to Ezrim.
events.quote: it's the chief who'd like to speak to you

events.summary: Kellan tells Kaya that his father is the fae planeswalker Oko and asks if she knows him.
events.quote: His name's Oko

events.summary: Ezrim offers Kaya leadership of the Zegana murder investigation.
events.quote: I would like you to assume leadership of this investigation.

events.summary: Kaya refuses Ezrim's offer and leaves.
events.quote: No. It's a complete sentence, and you know what it means.

events.summary: Proft visits Etrata in her isolated cell.
events.quote: Etrata's cell was the only one occupied in this block, leaving her entirely isolated, save for her guards

events.summary: Proft asks Etrata why she killed so publicly and how she fooled the verity circles.
events.quote: will you tell me why you chose to kill such a prominent target in such a public way?

events.summary: A courier summons Kaya to Karlov Manor with a note from Teysa.
events.quote: Guildmaster Karlov requests your presence at the manor.

events.summary: Teysa's note says it is time for the discussion they couldn't have and asks Kaya to come alone.
events.quote: It's time for the discussion we couldn't have during the gala.

events.summary: Kaya enters the unlocked, silent manor.
events.quote: The manor was eerily quiet, with no one in attendance or rushing to announce her.

events.summary: Kaya finds Teysa dead in her private parlor with her walking stick through her chest.
events.quote: the shattered shaft of her walking stick protruded from her chest, slick with blood.

events.summary: Kaya finds a note in Teysa's handwriting written in Phyrexian script.
events.quote: The script was Phyrexian.

events.summary: Kaya decides she must join Ezrim's investigation after all.
events.quote: She had to tell him she was in this after all.

events.summary: Etrata denies killing Zegana and says she does not remember it.
events.quote: If I killed her, I don't remember it.

events.summary: Proft reasons that if Etrata was mind-controlled she is no more culpable than a knife.
events.quote: if mind control or magic had been used to force Etrata's actions, she was no more culpable than a knife.

events.summary: Proft swears to clear Etrata's name, and she gives her word to help.
events.quote: I am Alquist Proft, and I will risk my name to clear yours.

events.summary: Proft unlocks Etrata's cell and tells her to meet him at his home.
events.quote: the lock on her cell sprang open with a click

events.summary: Etrata slips out into the shadows and Proft stages a scene over the empty cell.
events.quote: Etrata nodded before stepping out of the cell and melting into the shadows.

relations.quote: I, as head of the Agency

relations.note: she gives her word to help him
relations.quote: As much as I can, you have my word.

relations.note: snuck in as the Dimir's eyes
relations.quote: I snuck into the party because House Dimir needed someone to be our eyes

relations.note: former Azorius asset who left for the Agency
relations.quote: Proft had been their asset before he chose to go off and ply his talents with the Agency
they were sisters, in their way
